zh.title: Cummings Aerospace展示單人操控兩架Hellhound S3攻擊無人機
zh.summary: Cummings Aerospace於10月12日宣佈，8月25日在奧勒岡州以單一手持控制器同時操作兩架噴射動力Hellhound S3攻擊無人機。
body: Cummings Aerospace於10月12日宣佈，該公司已展示以單一手持控制器同時操作兩架噴射動力Hellhound S3攻擊無人機。公司表示，這項測試於2026年8月25日在奧勒岡州Pendleton UAS Range進行，兩架無人機自一具安裝於Polaris多用途車輛上的新型發射器依序發射。
公司指出，兩架無人機均搭載惰性酬載，並以不同速度飛行不同的預先程式化航線，由單一操作員監控兩架無人機的飛行。發射前，Cummings Aerospace工程師使用手持射控系統為每架Hellhound設定航點、高度與飛行路徑；升空後，無人機自主導航至指定航線，並與控制器交換資料，使操作員能即時監控兩次飛行，必要時可調整或中止任一任務。公司並未說明兩架無人機之間是否直接協同。
Cummings Aerospace執行長Sheila Cummings表示，這種方式可讓單一士兵「同時把多架Hellhound派往多個目標」。她說：「從一套手持系統控制多架S3，讓小型單位能產生以往需要整個砲兵連才能提供的火力。」公司表示，這次展示達成所有預定目標。
公司表示，這次測試創下Hellhound S3多項首次紀錄，包括首次由車輛搭載發射、首次連發（依序發射），以及首次由單一操作員透過同一套控制系統管理多架Hellhound。測試也首次使用可搭載最多八架Hellhound的新型發射器；公司稱該發射器輕到可由兩人抬舉，並可安裝於不同軍用車輛。先前Hellhound已完成十多次單兵攜行構型的飛行。
Hellhound S3為3D列印、渦輪噴射動力無人機，重約6公斤（13磅）。Cummings Aerospace將其描述為多任務武器，可作為徘徊彈藥、精確導引彈藥、單程攻擊無人機或反無人機武器。其模組化設計可讓操作員更換四種酬載：穿甲、爆破破片、電子作戰與誘餌模組。
公司聲稱S3速度可達約每小時618公里（每小時384英里），並能打擊60公里（37英里）以外目標，也稱其製造方式可實現每月交付超過100套系統。公司表示，這項射程說法依據先前一次飛行測試，當時一架S3飛行超過30公里（19英里），落地時仍剩餘超過一半燃料，公司據此推算潛在最大射程。

Cummings Aerospace表示，下一步目標包括自新型發射器齊射多架Hellhound S3，以及在無人地面與水面載具上測試該系統。公司並指出，2025年1月曾表示有意以Hellhound競逐美國陸軍Low Altitude Stalking and Strike Ordnance（LASSO）計畫；美國陸軍其後已將LASSO原型協議授予其他廠商，包括2026年2月授予Textron Systems的Damocles徘徊彈藥，以及2026年5月授予AeroVironment的Switchblade 400。

en.title: Cummings Aerospace demonstrates single-operator control of two Hellhound S3 attack drones
en.summary: Cummings Aerospace announced on October 12, 2026, that a single operator controlled two jet-powered Hellhound S3 attack drones from one handheld controller during an August 25, 2026 test in Oregon.
body: Cummings Aerospace announced on October 12, 2026, that it had demonstrated the simultaneous operation of two jet-powered Hellhound S3 attack drones using a single handheld controller. The company said the test took place on August 25, 2026, at the Pendleton UAS Range in Oregon, with the drones launched sequentially from a new launcher mounted on a Polaris utility vehicle.

According to the company, both drones carried inert payloads and flew different pre-programmed routes at different speeds, while a single operator monitored their flights. Before launch, a Cummings Aerospace engineer used the handheld fire control system to program waypoints, altitudes and flight paths for each Hellhound. Once airborne, the drones navigated their assigned routes autonomously, exchanging data with the controller. This allowed the operator to monitor both flights in real time and adjust or abort either mission if necessary. Cummings Aerospace did not describe direct coordination between the drones themselves.

Sheila Cummings, the company's CEO, said the approach would allow a single soldier to "simultaneously put multiple Hellhounds on multiple targets." "Controlling several S3s from one handheld system lets a small unit produce fires that used to take an entire battery," Cummings said. Cummings Aerospace said the demonstration met all its objectives.

The company said the test marked several firsts for the Hellhound S3, including its first vehicle-mounted launch, its first ripple-fire, or sequential launch, and the first time a single operator managed multiple Hellhounds through the same control system. It also marked the first use of a new launcher designed to carry up to eight Hellhounds. According to the company, the launcher is light enough to be lifted by two people and can be installed on different military vehicles. Previously, Hellhound had completed more than a dozen flights in its man-portable configuration.

The Hellhound S3 is a 3D-printed, turbojet-powered drone weighing approximately 6 kilograms (13 pounds). Cummings Aerospace describes it as a multi-mission weapon capable of serving as a loitering munition, precision-guided munition, one-way attack drone or counter-drone weapon. Its modular design allows operators to exchange four types of payload: armor-piercing, blast-fragmentation, electronic warfare, and decoy modules.

The company claims the S3 can reach speeds of around 618 kilometers per hour (384 miles per hour) and strike targets more than 60 kilometers (37 miles) away. It also says its manufacturing approach enables deliveries of more than 100 systems per month. The range claim is based on a previous flight test, during which an S3 flew more than 30 kilometers (19 miles) and landed with over half its fuel remaining. Cummings Aerospace extrapolated the potential maximum range from that result.

Cummings Aerospace said its next objectives include salvo-firing multiple Hellhound S3 drones from the new launcher and testing the system aboard unmanned ground and surface vehicles. In January 2025, the company said it intended to offer Hellhound for the US Army's Low Altitude Stalking and Strike Ordnance (LASSO) program. The US Army has since awarded LASSO prototype agreements to other manufacturers, including Textron Systems for its Damocles loitering munition in February 2026 and AeroVironment for its Switchblade 400 in May 2026.

zh.title: NetJets規劃新建三座美國航廈並擴大DJT專用設施
zh.summary: NetJets規劃美國三座新航廈，並擴大西棕櫚灘專用設施
body: NetJets於2026年10月12日表示，計畫在Dallas Love Field（DAL）、Washington Dulles International Airport（IAD）及Colorado的Rifle Garfield County Airport（RIL）設置新航廈。
Dallas Love Field的NetJets專用園區面積規劃為114,000平方英尺，預定於2028年末啟用。Washington Dulles的工程預定於2027年初展開；NetJets表示，Rifle Garfield County Airport的新園區預計於2027年初投入營運。
在West Palm Beach的Donald J. Trump International Airport（DJT），NetJets正轉往較大的專用航廈，並稱新設施的面積將由10,000平方英尺增至15,000平方英尺。

en.title: NetJets plans three US terminals and larger space at Donald J. Trump International
en.summary: NetJets plans three US terminals and a larger exclusive-use facility at DJT.
body: NetJets said on October 12, 2026, that customers will see new terminals at Dallas Love Field (DAL), Washington Dulles International Airport (IAD) and Rifle Garfield County Airport (RIL) in Colorado.

The planned NetJets-only complex at Dallas Love Field will cover 114,000 square feet and is set to open in late 2028. Construction at the Washington Dulles facility is scheduled to begin in early 2027. NetJets anticipates its new complex at Rifle Garfield County Airport will be operational by early 2027.

At Donald J. Trump International Airport (DJT) in West Palm Beach, NetJets is transitioning to a larger exclusive-use terminal. The company said the new facility will increase in size from 10,000 to 15,000 square feet.
